what_the_photos_show: Forest inside the outline in every photo up to 23 Jan 2024; by 8 Dec 2025 an earth cut and a new track run through it.
Green fields and wetland from 2013 to Jan 2023; levelled bare ground on 23 Jan 2024 (cleared just after the 2 Jan 2024 Landsat image, when 49 % of the patch was still vegetation); weeds by Dec 2025.
Open grassland and scrub on a hillside in every photo, dry in most, with tracks and bare patches later; no building. The loss is mostly grass that was greener in January 2014, plus thinning scrub.
Green ground and trees up to 6 Jan 2023; levelled bare earth by 23 Jan 2024; a building site in Dec 2025.
Dense trees up to 6 Jan 2023; a clearing and a new building by 23 Jan 2024; a long new building beside the railway by Oct 2025.
Scrub and trees, with a tower rising at the west edge from 2020; most of the patch still green on 21 Feb 2022 and cleared by 6 Jan 2023; high-rise towers by 2024-25.
A green field and trees beside the Aarey cattle sheds up to Dec 2016; bare by 25 Oct 2018; depot buildings and a curving access viaduct from 2020.
Green fields and trees up to 23 Dec 2016; a cleared site compound by 25 Oct 2018; construction, then the Metro depot's tracks and sheds by 2024.
Trees and scrub in Mar 2013; excavated foundations by 6 Jan 2016; high-rise towers from 2018.

Trees around older buildings in every photo; by Oct 2025 a new structure and track in the north-west of the patch, but much of the canopy is still there; the rest of the drop may be thinning or a dry January (first seen in 2026, not yet certain).

Follows our curve step by step: green fields and trees up to Dec 2016; cleared by 25 Oct 2018, a year before the October 2019 felling; bare with one tree clump in Feb 2020; weeds regrown by Feb 2022 while work was stopped; cleared again by Jan 2023; sheds and tracks from Jan 2024.

Bare ground and a large pond inside the outline in 2013-2016; the pond filled by Oct 2018 and the landfill grows after; the mangroves around the outline look the same in every photo - no lasting vegetation loss around it, as Day 4 found.
